meanings.en: a person who leaves school or a course before finishing

meanings.en: an exact copy of something

meanings.exampleEn: The ecologist warned about the loss of natural habitats.

meanings.en: using money, time, or resources carefully without waste

meanings.en: the quality of being graceful and stylish

meanings.tr: uygulamak, yürürlüğe koymak, zorla kabul ettirmek

meanings.exampleTr: Polis otoyolda hız sınırını uyguluyor.

meanings.exampleTr: İki plan esasen aynıdır.
